body:
Both verification gates pass cleanly. The `adapters/mod.rs` deletions are from a peer's concurrent split of `trait_def.rs` (not my edits); my changes there are docs-only additions. The 2 deletions in `open_mtr_client.rs` are the two old one-line doc comments I replaced with expanded determinism-contract docs.

Task complete. Summary of what was documented:

- **`lib.rs`** — crate root as pure domain+client core (no platform APIs; transport behind `HttpTransport`), plus the `result_large_err` allowance rationale (RFC 9457 details are part of the public error contract).
- **`openmtr/mod.rs`** — module-level docs for all 12 module declarations.
- **`prelude.rs`** — module doc covering the reexport groups.
- **`open_mtr_client.rs`** — `MtrResult`, `OpenMtrClient` (struct, constructors, all 21 operations with domain meaning), and the full builder including the determinism injection points (`clock` → `today()`, `id_generator` → envelope `id`), with `build_with_transport` tying them to `MtrCtx::with_determinism`.
- **`open_mtr_auth.rs`** — `AuthParams` variant/fields, `cpf_senha_unidade`, and all `OpenMtrClassicAuth` builder methods.
- **`resposta.rs`** — the `Resposta` envelope (id/ok/status/mensagem/dados/erros/total) and all constructors/predicate.
- **`system.rs`** — `System` variants, `default_base_url`, `adapter`, `nome`.
- **`time_util.rs`** — `Clock`/`IdGenerator` traits and methods, `FixedClock`, `SequentialIdGenerator`, `shared_clock`/`shared_id_generator`.
- **`adapters/mod.rs`** — `ItemResult`, `LoteResult` + methods, `HttpClient` alias, `MtrCtx` (+ `with_determinism`), and the `pub(crate)` helpers `validate_download`/`get_value`/`post_value`.

Verification:
- `cargo rustc ... -W missing_docs`: no diagnostics in any assigned file (in fact none repo-wide).
- `RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p open-mtr-core --no-deps`: clean build, no warnings.
- No code, signatures, derives, serde attributes, or tests changed. No commit made.
